description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI class, which extends API endpoint functionality to handle CRUD operations related to employee claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests, along with validation rules and access control logic.
